title: IPC peer path changed
description: The data of a `peer.path_changed` event (2.1): a peer the connection has a route to -- a direct message exchanged with it, or a broadcast received from it on one of its joins -- changed path, `direct | relayed` either way. Coalesced per peer to one pending: a newer change keeps the pending one's `previous` and takes the newer `current`, `reason_class` and `observed_at`; one whose `previous` equals its `current` is withdrawn. The IPC projection of `LocalSessionEvent::PeerPathChanged` and of TRANSPORT.md's `PeerPathChanged`.
